text:
Which property is shown by aqueous ethanoic acid?
A
It reacts with magnesium to form water.
B
It turns red litmus blue.
C
It reacts with copper to form hydrogen gas.
D
It reacts with copper(II) carbonate to form carbon dioxide gas.

options.label: A
options.text: It reacts with magnesium to form water.

options.label: C
options.text: It reacts with copper to form hydrogen gas.

options.label: D
options.text: It reacts with copper(II) carbonate to form carbon dioxide gas.
